titles.title: Hills Before Taos

credit_line: Montgomery Museum of Fine Arts, Montgomery, Alabama, The Blount Collection
description: Soft, featureless blue hills span the width of the canvas. Below the hills is an expanse of light brown earth covered in greenish-blue bushes. A blue sky with soft white clouds stretches overhead.
title: Hills Before Taos
